summary: Materialize the Choros Postgres substrate every prior ADR was written against: a postgres:16 service in docker-compose (dev creds via env), a zero-dep Node migration runner with schema_migrations bookkeeping and skip-applied idempotency, baseline migrations 001-009 creating the ratified choros_* schema (job, application/registry_def/record JSONB object model, audit_event/audit_head, grant, object_handle) with the full T-0013 tenant-table convention (tenant_id NOT NULL leading PK, scoped uniqueness, FORCE RLS default-DENY) from migration #1, the non-owner/non-BYPASSRLS app role + separate migrator/owner role, ACT_* schema readiness (Flowable NOT installed), and an integration-honest CI gate that runs migrations, proves idempotency, and runs them with >=2 tenants. 18 CI-checkable acceptance criteria.
functional: FR-1 postgres:16 service in docker-compose, dev creds via env
FR-2 zero-dep Node migration runner, schema_migrations bookkeeping, skip-applied idempotency, DATABASE_URL/migrator role
FR-3 baseline choros_* schema 001-009 = ratified object model only (job, application, registry_def, record, audit_event, audit_head, grant, object_handle); no FK to undesigned tables
FR-4 T-0013 tenant-table convention structural in DDL from migration #1 (tenant_id NOT NULL leading PK, scoped uniqueness, FORCE RLS, default-DENY on choros.tenant_id GUC)
FR-5 choros_app (NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS, non-owner, DML-only) + choros_migrator (owner, DDL, never runtime)
FR-6 ACT_* schema/role readiness for future Flowable; Flowable itself NOT installed
FR-7 CI gate: migrations apply, idempotency re-run, >=2-tenant check; integration-honest; pg added only here
non_functional: NF-1 zero-dep runner (only pg client), no migration framework for choros_*
NF-3 one schema/one RLS path silo and pooled
NF-5 dev/prod credential separation (no prod secret committed)
out_of_scope: role/assignment tables and any undesigned-model table
withTenant TS runtime wrapper + live RLS-probe app code (T-0114/identity tasks)

acceptance_criteria.text: docker-compose defines a Postgres 16 service that comes up ready; params from env with dev defaults, no committed prod secret
runner applies all migrations on empty DB (exit 0, every file recorded in schema_migrations, all baseline tables exist)
runner idempotent: re-run applies zero migrations, schema_migrations unchanged, no DDL re-error
schema_migrations(version text PK, applied_at timestamptz); duplicate version -> PK violation
every baseline tenant table has ENABLE+FORCE RLS (pg_class probe returns empty)
default-DENY: choros_app with no SET LOCAL choros.tenant_id -> count 0 on every tenant table
tenant_id leading column of every composite index and FK on tenant tables
scoped uniqueness: same business key ok across tenants, duplicate within one tenant -> unique violation
tenant_id NOT NULL enforced at DB layer (NULL insert as migrator -> NOT NULL violation)
choros_app rolbypassrls=f, rolsuper=f, and not owner of any tenant table
choros_migrator owns tenant tables + holds DDL; choros_app CREATE TABLE fails
choros_app DML scoped per table; UPDATE/DELETE on audit_event fails (SELECT/INSERT only); no DDL grant
migrations idempotent and consistent with >=2 tenants (anti-decorative tenant_id, tenancy §9 guard 5)
no baseline FK targets an undesigned/non-existent table; all FKs resolve within baseline
JSONB columns present and typed jsonb (registry_def.record_schema, record.data, audit_event.payload, grant scope)
ACT_* readiness (schema/role boundary) without installing Flowable; zero ACT_* tables after migrations
CI integration-honest with Postgres service: runner + idempotency re-run + >=2-tenant check; npm run ci green; worktrees excluded
pg dependency declared exactly once in package.json; runner imports only Node builtins + pg
